Description: Infection occurs at a rate proportional to the number of infectious individuals and the transmission rate.
Transition from the first to the second stage of incubation at rate σ.
Transition from the second stage of incubation to the first stage of being infectious at rate σ.
Transition from the first to the second stage of being infectious at rate γ.
Recovery from the second stage of being infectious at rate γ.

Name: σ
Description: Rate of transition from Exposed 1 to Exposed 2 and from Exposed 2 to Infectious 1.

Name: γ
Description: Rate of transition from Infectious 1 to Infectious 2 and from Infectious 2 to Recovered.

Name: β
Description: Transmission rate at which new infections take place given a contact.
